description: Drought, state, 1972 - 2022 is a dataset listed in Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Reporting - Public. We report on drought frequency, duration, severity, and intensity at three different time scales, short-term (3 months), medium-term (6 months) and long-term (12 months). These different time scales are approximately equivalent to meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought, respectively. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Reporting - Public. Its tags are CLIMATE-AND-WEATHER-Drought, New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2024-02-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-mfe-portal.
